kurz: A good steak needs two things at once: a dry, very hot surface for the crust and a gently warmed inside.
bild_im_kopf: A grill outside, a bathtub inside.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Salt the day before and chill uncovered
schluesselmomente.warum: Salt soaks in and holds water; the surface dries.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Pat dry and preheat the pan hard
schluesselmomente.warum: Only a dry surface in a hot pan browns.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Turn as soon as it releases; cook with a thermometer
schluesselmomente.warum: The [[kerntemperatur|core temperature]] decides between juicy and dry.

schluesselmomente.schritt: At the end, butter, garlic and thyme for basting
schluesselmomente.warum: Foaming butter adds aroma and extra browning.

schluesselmomente.schritt: Rest briefly and slice across the grain
schluesselmomente.warum: Less juice runs out, and shorter fibres feel more tender.
